params.name: steps
params.meaning: number of sigmas; also changes the schedule shift (mu depends on steps for seq_len <= 4300)

official_reference_code.dev: num_inference_steps=50, '28 steps can be a good trade-off'

params.interactions: distilled klein above 4 steps: no official guidance (NOT FOUND); community: base '16 to 24 steps' is enough

params.name: guidance
params.meaning: distilled guidance embedding — FLUX.2 [dev] only (klein templates have no FluxGuidance)
params.interactions: no negative prompt on dev (BasicGuider); the template keeps 4 even with the Turbo LoRA

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: real classifier-free guidance with the negative prompt — klein only
params.interactions: cfg > 1 doubles compute; distilled models break with cfg > 1; base at cfg 1 is noisy/undercooked

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: 128-channel latent at 1/16 (step 16); Flux2Scheduler must receive the SAME values — its sigmas come from compute_empirical_mu over the image sequence length (w*h)/256; edit templates take both from GetImageSize of the 1-MP reference
params.interactions: larger output -> longer schedule shift automatically; a scheduler size that disagrees with the latent gives wrong contrast / soft output

params.name: reference images
params.meaning: one ReferenceLatent per image, chained; each image scaled to 1.0 MP (lanczos, area or nearest-exact in templates); with CFGGuider the reference goes on BOTH positive and negative
params.interactions: each reference adds tokens -> VRAM ('Enhanced Flux2 reference image memory estimation' v0.3.75); KV cache speeds multi-ref (1.40x at 1 ref, 2.22x at 4)

params.name: reference method
params.meaning: FLUX.2 default 'index' with ref_index_scale 10.0 (model_detection); FluxKVCache forces 'index_timestep_zero'; FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod can override (offset, index, uxo/uno, index_timestep_zero)

params.name: strength_model
params.interactions: steps must drop to 8 with it ('Remember to set the steps to 8')

params.name: VAE decoder
params.meaning: flux2-vae.safetensors (full) or full_encoder_small_decoder.safetensors (full encoder + distilled decoder: '~1.4x faster decoding', '~1.4x less VRAM at decode time', 'Minimal quality loss'; ComfyUI >= 0.19.0)

params.name: text encoder precision
params.meaning: dev: Mistral bf16 35.6 GB / fp8 18 GB / fp4 12.3 GB; klein 9B: Qwen3-8B 16.4 / 8.7 / 6.8 GB; klein 4B: Qwen3-4B 8.0 / 3.8 GB; device = cpu keeps the encoder off the GPU
params.interactions: the bf16 Mistral + fp8 transformer is the classic OOM; v0.3.73/v0.4.0 fixed encoder memory accounting

params.name: prompt length
params.meaning: ComfyUI pads/crops the Mistral embeddings to 512 tokens (Flux2.extra_conds target_text_len = 512); klein pads to min_length 512; (word:1.2) weighting is not applied for dev (disable_weights=True)
params.interactions: BFL's '32K tokens' applies to the API models, not the ComfyUI dev path

params.name: denoise
params.meaning: not exposed: the custom-sampler pattern runs the full Flux2Scheduler schedule; edits are full re-generations conditioned by ReferenceLatent (the latent_image is always an EmptyFlux2LatentImage)

rules.message: FLUX.2 text encoding is a single CLIPLoader with type 'flux2' (Mistral-3 for dev, Qwen3 for klein) — not DualCLIPLoader/clip_l+t5
FLUX.2 [dev] encodes text with Mistral-Small-3.2-24B (mistral_3_small_flux2_*); a Qwen3 encoder belongs to klein
klein 4B models use the Qwen3-4B embedder (qwen_3_4b*.safetensors)
klein 9B models (incl. KV) use the '8B Qwen3 text embedder' (qwen_3_8b*.safetensors)

FLUX.2 latents are 128-channel at 1/16: decode/encode with flux2-vae.safetensors or full_encoder_small_decoder.safetensors. The FLUX.1 ae.safetensors (16-ch) gives a channel-mismatch error; small_decoder.safetensors alone cannot encode references
FLUX.2 samples from EmptyFlux2LatentImage ([B,128,H/16,W/16]); EmptySD3LatentImage / EmptyLatentImage are the wrong shape
EmptyFlux2LatentImage takes width/height in multiples of 16
every FLUX.2 template schedules with Flux2Scheduler(steps, width, height) -> SamplerCustomAdvanced, never KSampler/BasicScheduler: the shift is computed from the image sequence length

args.note: equal literal values, or both linked to the same upstream output (GetImageSize)

rules.message: Flux2Scheduler.width/height must equal EmptyFlux2LatentImage.width/height (same literals or the same GetImageSize link): the sigmas depend on (width*height)/256, and a stale scheduler size after a resolution change gives wrong contrast / soft output
FLUX.2 all-in-one checkpoints fail with 'clip input is invalid: None' (Flux2.clip_target() returns None); always UNETLoader + CLIPLoader(flux2) + VAELoader — there is no Comfy-Org FLUX.2 checkpoint
FLUX.2 [dev] is guidance-distilled: every dev template carries FluxGuidance 4 (BFL guidance_scale=4; fal Turbo 2.5) into a BasicGuider — no negative prompt
dev templates use BasicGuider (distilled guidance); a CFGGuider on dev must run cfg 1 — the negative prompt has no effect ('Most FLUX models do not support negative prompts')
no klein template uses FluxGuidance: klein steers with CFGGuider (base: real CFG + negative; distilled: cfg 1)
distilled klein (4b / 9b / 9b-kv, no 'base') runs at cfg 1 with ConditioningZeroOut as negative (BFL guidance_scale=1.0); 'distilled models break with cfg > 1'
distilled klein is a 4-step model (BFL num_inference_steps=4, all distilled templates 4); no official guidance exists for more steps
klein base is undistilled: real CFG with a negative prompt, templates 5 / BFL 4.0; at cfg 1 and 4 steps it looks noisy/undercooked
klein base templates run 20 steps (BFL 50; community '16 to 24 steps' is enough)
the Turbo LoRAs are 'A distilled LoRA adapter for FLUX.2 [dev]'; not for klein
with the Turbo LoRA set Flux2Scheduler steps to 8 ('Remember to set the steps to 8'); the template's switch does both
use the ComfyUI conversions (Flux_2-Turbo-LoRA_comfyui / Flux2TurboComfyv2); fal's raw flux.2-turbo-lora.safetensors 'is not suitable for ComfyUI'
the klein 9B KV model expects the KV path: UNETLoader -> FluxKVCache -> guider (ComfyUI >= 0.17.0; batch-split crash fixed in 0.25.0)
every FLUX.2 template scales each reference to 1.0 megapixel before VAEEncode; larger references add tokens and VRAM

args.note: walk positive and negative upstream; each VAEEncode'd reference latent must appear on both

rules.message: with CFGGuider the reference latent is attached to BOTH the positive and the negative conditioning (klein templates: one ReferenceLatent per image per branch); a reference on one branch only is a wrong CFG
NVFP4 files need Blackwell (RTX 50 / sm120); on 40-series they fail or run slow (issue #11864) — use the fp8 files there
fp8 weights save VRAM everywhere but are faster only on Ada (RTX 40) and newer; Ampere (RTX 30) upcasts — GGUF Q8_0/Q6_K is the usual alternative. Answer: fine on an Ada/Blackwell box
the FLUX.2 Small Decoder VAE needs ComfyUI >= 0.19.0 ('Added support for small flux.2 decoder', 2026-04-13); the pinned 0.35.0 image has it — recipes using it carry min_comfyui 0.19.0

FLUX.2 support landed in 0.3.72 (dev), 0.9.2 (klein), 0.17.0 (FluxKVCache), 0.19.0 (small decoder); all below the pinned 0.35.0. The klein 9B outpainting template needs DrawMaskOnImage/ColorMatch which are absent from v0.35.0

prompting.negative_gloss: dev: none (distilled, BasicGuider). klein base: a real negative is wired (CFGGuider cfg 5) but every template leaves it empty and BFL offers no guidance for it (NOT FOUND). klein distilled: ConditioningZeroOut.

positive.line: Structure: [SUBJECT], [LOCATION], [STYLE], [CAMERA SETTINGS], [LIGHTING], [COLORS], [EFFECT], [ADDITIONAL ELEMENTS] — 'a prompt-building aid, not a rule'; 'Start short. Add only what changes the image.'; 'Specific detail helps. Filler hurts.'; most important elements first
No negations: 'no people' -> 'empty', 'deserted'; 'no text' -> 'clean surfaces', 'unmarked'; 'not dark' -> 'brightly lit'; 'not many' -> 'few', 'single'

Photorealism: name camera and lens ('Shot on Hasselblad X2D, 80mm lens, f/2.8, natural lighting'); era styles ('2000s digicam aesthetic'); hex colours ('walls in hex #C4725A'); text in quotes with placement/style ('The text OPEN appears in red neon letters')

Single-reference edits: 'FLUX.2 understands the context of your image and applies edits while preserving what you didn't ask to change' — 'Change it to Night'; 'Remove all of the sprinkles while keeping the rest of the image unchanged'; 'Change the cow's white fur to the color #8bc4bb'; 'Be specific about what should change and what should stay'

Multi-reference: 'describe the role of each image so the model knows what to pull from where' — refer to 'image 1', 'image 2' in load order: 'A photograph of the woman in image 2 sitting on the swing in image 1 and the cat from image 3 sitting on her lap, all in the style of image 4'

Template prompts follow the same pattern: 'Apply the design from Reference Image 1 onto objects in Reference Image 2.' (dev); 'Have the man in Figure 1 put on the clothes from Figure 2 ...' (klein KV); long preservation clauses for klein base ('Keep the person in the exact same position, scale, and pose. Maintain identical camera angle, framing, and perspective ...')

ComfyUI wraps the dev prompt in a Mistral system prompt ('You are an AI that reasons about image descriptions ...') and the klein prompt in a Qwen3 chat template with thinking disabled; (word:1.2) weights are not applied for dev
Budget in the ComfyUI dev path: 512 tokens (padded/cropped); BFL's '32K tokens' is for the API models

prompting.structure: subject, location, style, camera, lighting, colors, effect; for edits: what changes + what stays; for several references: the role of each image by number

hurts.line: many simultaneous edits without explicit preservation clauses
very long prompts in the ComfyUI dev path (512-token pad/crop)
text to render that is not quoted; the card: 'text rendered may be inaccurate or subject to distortion'

pitfalls.symptom: OOM when the text encoder loads / on the first step ('torch.OutOfMemoryError: Allocation on device')
pitfalls.cause: 35.6 GB bf16 Mistral + 35 GB fp8 transformer; early versions mis-accounted memory
pitfalls.fix: mistral_3_small_flux2_fp8 or _fp4_mixed; CLIPLoader.device = cpu; plenty of system RAM (64-96 GB reported); the 0.35.0 image is past the v0.3.73 / v0.4.0 fixes

pitfalls.symptom: 'clip input is invalid: None' with a FLUX.2 all-in-one checkpoint
pitfalls.cause: Flux2.clip_target() returns None — AIO checkpoints' text encoders are not loaded
pitfalls.fix: UNETLoader + CLIPLoader(flux2) + VAELoader; there is no Comfy-Org FLUX.2 checkpoint

pitfalls.symptom: channel-mismatch error at VAE decode / garbage output
pitfalls.cause: FLUX.1 ae.safetensors (16 ch) with FLUX.2 (128 ch), or EmptySD3LatentImage instead of EmptyFlux2LatentImage

pitfalls.symptom: wrong contrast / soft output after changing resolution
pitfalls.cause: Flux2Scheduler width/height not updated — sigmas depend on (width*height)/256
pitfalls.fix: wire the same width/height (or GetImageSize) into both EmptyFlux2LatentImage and Flux2Scheduler

pitfalls.symptom: klein base looks noisy/undercooked at 4 steps, or distilled looks burnt
pitfalls.fix: base: 20 steps, CFGGuider 4-5, a negative; distilled: 4 steps, cfg 1, negative = ConditioningZeroOut
accept the agreement on each black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-*9b* repo; Comfy-Org hosts only the 9B encoder + VAE

pitfalls.symptom: old template links Comfy-Org/flux2-klein, flux2-klein-4B, flux2-klein-9B

pitfalls.cause: steps not set to 8, or fal's raw flux.2-turbo-lora.safetensors loaded

pitfalls.symptom: fp8 no faster on RTX 30-series; NVFP4 fails or slow on 40-series
pitfalls.cause: Ampere lacks FP8 tensor cores; NVFP4 needs Blackwell sm120
pitfalls.fix: 30-series: GGUF Q8_0/Q6_K; 40-series: fp8; 50-series: NVFP4 (issue #11864 for 5090 load failures)

pitfalls.symptom: reference image ignored or output the wrong size
pitfalls.cause: reference not VAE-encoded through ReferenceLatent, or latent size not taken from the reference
pitfalls.fix: scale each reference to 1 MP, VAEEncode, chain ReferenceLatent (both branches with CFGGuider), size from GetImageSize

pitfalls.symptom: KV model used without FluxKVCache / crash with split batches
pitfalls.cause: the model expects the KV path; batch-split bug
pitfalls.fix: FluxKVCache after UNETLoader; ComfyUI >= 0.25.0 for the batch fix (the 0.35.0 image has it)

pitfalls.symptom: negative prompt has no effect on dev
pitfalls.fix: only FluxGuidance matters; use positive phrasing

pitfalls.cause: model limitation ('text rendered may be inaccurate or subject to distortion')
pitfalls.fix: quote the exact text, specify font/placement; retry seeds

pitfalls.symptom: two different files both named flux2-vae.safetensors
pitfalls.cause: Comfy-Org/flux2-dev (sha d64f3a68...) vs the klein repos (sha 868fe7b3...)
pitfalls.fix: both are FLUX.2 VAEs; prefer the file the template links; quality difference NOT FOUND

pitfalls.symptom: GGUF text encoder stays in RAM -> low-RAM OOM; klein-4B 'extremely high VRAM'
pitfalls.fix: update; v0.11.0 'Flux2 Klein memory estimation adjustments'
